name: Claim Line Accounting Classification V2
requiresDatabases: Rental D1 finance claim workflow with additive claim-line classification schema

dataIsolation.guard: Each submission remains bound to its signed tenant and source binding; category and business-unit identifiers are validated against the tenant configuration and Rental allowlist.

definitionOfDone: The form requires an explicit claim type instead of selecting the first type implicitly
Every line includes description, amount, category, service month, and business unit
Description-based suggestions remain editable and unknown items fail closed
Intercompany invoice tax is labeled as company-current clearing and never as deductible input VAT
Rental approval shows the claim type and an accounting preview before posting
A paid claim can be reclassified with an auditable journal while preserving its payment record
Claims and governance dry runs, package check, and alignment audit pass
